resources.string: Paid consultations are not available in your country right now. Your bookings carry on as normal.
Give it a title, choose the lengths you sell (15 minutes to an hour and a half) and a price for each. You can list several, each with its own price and hours.
Set the weekly hours clients can ask for. Accept a request and that time is yours; nobody else can take it, from any of your consultations.
The Dorr team looks at it, then clients find it next to the ready-made services. The client pays when asking and Dorr holds it; you get it after the session.
Bookings show here as soon as a client takes one of your times.
A short title and what the client gets from talking to you.
e.g. Advice on your brand identity
Who it is for, what you cover, and what to prepare.
Pick up to %1$d lengths and set a price for each.
Clients book inside these hours only. Add more than one range to a day if you need a break.
Times are in your phone\'s zone: %1$s
Clients book at least %1$d hours ahead and up to %2$d days ahead.
The client pays in full when asking; Dorr holds the money. A request needs your answer within %1$d hours (or before it starts), otherwise it is cancelled and given back.
If the client cancels %1$d hours or more before, they get it all back; later, you are paid. If you cancel, they always get it all back.
After the session the client has %1$d hours to report a problem; then the money is yours.
Enter a price for every length you chose (at least 1).
Choose at least one length to take bookings.
Switch on at least one day to take bookings.
Check the hours: each end must be after its start, and ranges on one day must not overlap.
What the client wants to talk about
The client gets all their money back and is told at once. Cancelling often lowers clients\' trust.
Cancelled; the client got their money back
Accepted. The client was told and the time is yours.
The client gets everything back at once and is told, so they can pick another time.
Declined. The client got the money back.

The client has paid and Dorr holds the money. Accept to take this time, or decline. Answer by %1$s, otherwise it is cancelled and given back. Other requests for these hours are declined when you accept.
You declined it and the client got the money back.
You did not answer in time, so it was cancelled and the client got the money back.
You accepted another request for those hours, so this one was given back to the client.
%1$d consultation request(s) waiting for your answer
The money is held and the time is yours. The session is a video call; it opens here at the time.
It is time now. The video call starts here soon.
If the client reports nothing, the money is yours on %1$s.
Done and paid. The money is in your earnings.
The client reported a problem. The Dorr team is looking at it and will tell you both.
After looking at the complaint, the money went back to the client.
You cancelled it; the client got all their money back.
The client cancelled in time and got their money back.
The client cancelled late, so you were paid.
The Dorr team is looking at it. Clients see it once it is approved.
Sent. Clients see it once the Dorr team approves it.
A new or changed consultation is looked at by the Dorr team before clients see it.
If you change it, it goes back to the Dorr team before clients see the change.
“%1$s” will be removed. Bookings already made keep their money and time.
Give the consultation a title (at least 3 letters).
The client can rate it until %1$s.
It shows on your profile and counts in your rating.
